_doc: Per-agent CORE skills (permanent, every project, auto-attached) — the project-type bundle from config/skills/global-skills.json comes ON TOP. Skill Boss validates before dispatch: an agent may not start without its core skills resolvable (real skill, playbook, ECC agent, or documented method) — missing → report + labeled safe fallback.
_wp15_note: WP 1.5 (2026-10-24): LEGACY MIRROR. The agent .md frontmatter is now the single source of truth for every per-agent fact; .claude/config/agents/agents.generated.json is generated from it (node .claude/forge-bin/forge-registry-gen.cjs agents --write) and forge-doctor `agents` cross-checks this file against it. This file stays, kept consistent, until a later wave removes it: change the agent frontmatter first, then this mirror, then regenerate. Cross-checked here: every skill in an agent's frontmatter `skills:` preload list must be listed for it below. Situational skills (invocationNotes) and disable-model-invocation skills stay listed here but are not preloaded.
autoAttach: Two different things (corrected WP 2.4a, 2026-10-24). (1) PRELOAD: the agent .md frontmatter `skills:` list (a subset of this map) is what Claude Code injects at startup, the FULL SKILL.md text into every dispatch of that agent, so it holds only what the agent needs on every dispatch. (2) ON DEMAND: shipped agents have no Skill tool, so every other skill listed here for an agent is not auto-loaded; the agent Reads it from disk when relevant (.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, else ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md), or the Lead quotes it in the dispatch prompt together with the project-type bundle from config/skills/global-skills.json. No manual per-project reconnection.
honesty: Entries marked (ECC agent)/(method)/(tools) are agents, procedures, or tools — not SKILL.md files; they are invoked as what they are. Never claim a skill loaded that didn't.

invocationNotes._doc: When a core skill above is only used in a specific situation. The array entries stay plain skill names (they must resolve to .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md); the condition lives here. Added 2026-09-24 (wp13b + wp6b vendoring).
invocationNotes.forge-prompt-coach: boss: not preloaded (WP 2.4a). Intake is the Lead's step (forge.md BUILD BY DEFAULT setup: at most ONE owner question via forge-prompt-coach); Boss Reads it from disk only when it handles a raw owner request itself (silent: at most one question; config intake/prompt-doctor/explain-mode).
invocationNotes.grill-me: boss: only when config intake = interview, or when the owner asks to be grilled / questioned hard about a plan.
invocationNotes.grilling: boss: only when config intake = interview, or when the owner asks to be grilled / questioned hard about a plan.
invocationNotes.wait-what: docs-boss: re-explain when a message did not land with the owner (config explain-mode).
invocationNotes.resolving-merge-conflicts: build-boss: when a git merge or rebase stops on a conflict.
invocationNotes.setup-pre-commit: build-boss: USER-INVOKED ONLY - it runs npm/npx and installs Husky + lint-staged into the repo; never invoke it unless the owner explicitly asks for pre-commit hooks.
invocationNotes.forge-skill-testing: build-boss: not preloaded (WP 2.4a); Read from disk only when its package creates or changes a skill. test-boss and skill-boss preload it.
invocationNotes.forge-prd: head-chef: not preloaded (WP 2.4a); the Lead/Boss write the PRD, Head Chef Reads the skill from disk when it needs the PRD format or amends a PRD (its own body carries the forge-prd.cjs clarifications check). boss and docs-boss preload it.
invocationNotes.forge-router: skill-boss: not preloaded (WP 2.4a); Skill Boss Reads it from disk for the Step 0b Skill Discovery rules. boss and head-chef preload it.

_unshipped_removed_2026_09_23._doc: External audit II-E: these were skills not shipped in this payload (some exist only in an owner's global ~/.claude/skills, others were never Forge skills at all - see the 2026-09-24 correction below), so on a clean install every Boss dispatch tripped the unresolvable-core-skill fallback by design. Known equivalents were remapped to the shipped Forge skill; the rest are listed here so the intent is not lost. An owner who installs a missing one globally may add it back.
_unshipped_removed_2026_09_23._refilled: 2026-09-23 (external audit, measured): after the unshipped skills were dropped, ui-boss, seo-boss and skill-boss were left with EMPTY core-skill lists and nvidia-provider.test ("every registry agent has core skills") went red on every fresh install. Refilled from skills that actually ship: ui-boss -> forge-website/forge-mobile/forge-verify, seo-boss -> forge-website/forge-scout/forge-verify, skill-boss -> forge-scout/forge-skill-testing/forge-router.

(1) 'forge-website (SEO/perf sections)' is dropped from removed.seo-boss - forge-website DOES ship (.claude/skills/forge-website/SKILL.md exists) and was already restored into the live agents.ui-boss and agents.seo-boss core-skill lists above by the 2026-09-23 refill directly above; nothing further needed restoring. (2) 'nvidia-provider (forge-bin/nvidia-provider.cjs)' is dropped from removed.integration-boss - it is a forge-bin TOOL, not a Forge skill (no .claude/skills/nvidia-provider directory), so it never belonged in a skills-removed list; integration-boss still uses it as a tool, invoked as what it is, per this file's own honesty field.
